tool_schemas.name: get-reports
tool_schemas.description: Lists Audiense Insights reports visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status, segmentation_type, country, or external_report_id, and returns results sorted as requested. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or out-of-range limit, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to list reports, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request volume.

country.description: Filter reports by country (free-form country name/code as stored).

sort.description: Sort order for results (prefix with '-' for descending).

limit.description: Maximum number of reports to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-report-info
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single intelligence report by report_id, including lifecycle status, segmentation type, audience size, and access links; when include_segments=true we also return the report’s segments. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if report_id does not match the expected format, NOT_FOUND if the report_id does not exist or is not accessible to you, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to view the report.

include_segments.description: Whether to include the report's segments in the response.

tool_schemas.name: get-audience-insights
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated audience-level insight artifacts for audience_id (distributions across supported demographic, behavioral, and psychographic attributes), optionally compared against baseline_id and optionally scoped by categories and/or time_range. If refresh=true, we recompute when the cached artifact is stale; otherwise we return the latest cached artifact when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid time_range (e.g., from > to), or invalid categories values, NOT_FOUND if audience_id (or baseline_id, when provided) does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT if the audience/report is not in a state that can produce insights yet, and RATE_LIMITED when compute/read quotas are exceeded.

audience_id.description: Audience ID to retrieve aggregated insights for.

baseline_id.description: Baseline reference ID to use for comparisons (ref_type=baseline).

categories.description: Optional affinity category keys to scope/organize insight output.

from.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for computing insights.

to.description: End of the time range (inclusive) for computing insights.

time_range.description: Optional time window to scope insights computation.

refresh.description: If true, recompute if cached artifact is expired/stale instead of only reading cache.

tool_schemas.name: get-baselines
tool_schemas.description: Lists baseline reference datasets, optionally filtered by country and status, and returns them in a cursor-paginated collection (up to limit per page plus a next cursor when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status values or out-of-range limit, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to reference data. Returns RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request volume.

country.description: Filter baselines by country (free-form country name/code as stored).

limit.description: Maximum number of baselines to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-categories
tool_schemas.description: Lists affinity categories available for organizing or scoping insights, optionally filtered by status and country, returned as a cursor-paginated collection (up to limit per page plus a next cursor when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status values or out-of-range limit, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to reference data. Returns RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request volume.

status.description: Filter affinity categories by reference status.

country.description: Optional country filter if categories are localized in stored reference data.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: compare-audience-influencers
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns an influencer comparison for the given audience_id across the requested affinity category keys (categories), optionally compared against baseline_id and optionally scoped to time_range. If refresh=true, we recompute when the cached comparison is stale; otherwise we return the latest cached artifact when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing/empty categories, invalid time_range (e.g., from > to), or unknown category keys, NOT_FOUND if audience_id (or baseline_id, when provided) does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT if the audience/report is not in a state that can produce this comparison yet, and RATE_LIMITED when compute/read quotas are exceeded.

audience_id.description: Audience ID to compute influencer comparison for.

baseline_id.description: Baseline reference ID to compare influencers against (ref_type=baseline).

categories.description: Affinity category keys to include in the influencer comparison.

from.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for computing the comparison.

to.description: End of the time range (inclusive) for computing the comparison.

time_range.description: Optional time window to scope the influencer comparison.

refresh.description: If true, recompute if cached artifact is expired/stale instead of only reading cache.

tool_schemas.name: get-audience-content
tool_schemas.description: Returns audience content-engagement artifacts for audience_id (e.g., top liked/shared items and related breakdowns), optionally compared against baseline_id and optionally scoped to time_range. If refresh=true, we recompute when the cached artifact is stale; otherwise we return the latest cached artifact when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or invalid time_range (e.g., from > to), NOT_FOUND if audience_id (or baseline_id, when provided) does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT if the audience/report is not in a state that can produce content analytics yet, and RATE_LIMITED when compute/read quotas are exceeded.

audience_id.description: Audience ID to retrieve content engagement for.

baseline_id.description: Baseline reference ID to use for comparisons (ref_type=baseline).

from.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for computing content engagement.

to.description: End of the time range (inclusive) for computing content engagement.

time_range.description: Optional time window to scope content engagement.

refresh.description: If true, recompute if cached artifact is expired/stale instead of only reading cache.

tool_schemas.name: report-summary
tool_schemas.description: Generates or returns a cached summary for report_id in the requested summary_format (markdown, html, or json), optionally using prompt_profile to select the generation profile. If refresh=true, we regenerate even when a cached summary exists; otherwise we return the existing cached summary when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed report_id or unsupported summary_format, NOT_FOUND if the report does not exist or is not accessible, CONFLICT if the report is not ready to summarize (e.g., still syncing/failed) or required artifacts are unavailable, and RATE_LIMITED when generation/read quotas are exceeded.

report_id.description: Report ID to generate/read a cached summary for.

prompt_profile.description: Prompt profile identifier used to generate the summary.

refresh.description: If true, regenerate the summary even if a cached one exists.

tool_schemas.name: create-report
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Audiense Insights intelligence report from an external_report_id (and optional metadata). The report is created in status=created and must be moved to syncing to start ingestion. Refuses invalid segmentation_type values, missing/duplicate external_report_id, or requests from callers without write permission (UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN). Returns the created intelligence_report.

external_report_id.description: Vendor/external report identifier to attach to this intelligence report.

segmentation_type.description: Segmentation strategy used by the report.

audience_size.description: Optional total audience size for the report (if known at creation time).

tool_schemas.name: update-report
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an intelligence report and/or performs supported lifecycle transitions via status. Allowed status transitions: created→syncing|archived; syncing→ready|failed|archived; ready→syncing|archived; failed→syncing|archived. Refuses invalid transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), updates to inaccessible reports (NOT_FOUND), and writes without permission (UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN). Returns the updated intelligence_report.

status.description: Set report lifecycle status to drive ingestion/archival; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: create-report-segment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new segment under an intelligence report. The segment is created in status=created and can be moved to syncing to start segment-level ingestion. Refuses creation for archived reports, invalid report_id/audience_id formats, or missing permissions. Returns the created report_segment.

rank.description: Optional segment ordering rank (lower ranks sort first).

tool_schemas.name: update-report-segment
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a report segment and/or performs supported lifecycle transitions via status. Allowed status transitions: created→syncing|archived; syncing→ready|failed|archived; ready→syncing|archived; failed→syncing|archived. Refuses invalid transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), attempts to delete via status, or updates to inaccessible segments (NOT_FOUND). Returns the updated report_segment.

status.description: Set segment lifecycle status; must follow allowed transitions.
